;Business and economy
*[[China–United Kingdom relations]], [[One Belt One Road Initiative]]
**The [[BBC]] reports that former [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom]] [[David Cameron]] is to head a £750 million ($1 billion) U.K. private fund to improve air, road and railway links between [[China]] and its trading partners. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/former-prime-minister-david-cameron-chancellor-philip-hammond-750-million-trading-uk-london-china-a8114211.html (''The Independent'')] [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2017/dec/16/david-cameron-to-lead-750m-uk-china-investment-initiative (''The Guardian'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[December 2017 Southern California wildfires]]
** More evacuations are ordered as surging [[Santa Ana winds]] drive the 40-percent contained [[Thomas Fire]], now the third-largest in California history,  further westward in [[Santa Barbara County, California|Santa Barbara County]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-wildfires/winds-fuel-california-wildfire-states-third-largest-on-record-idUSKBN1EA097 (Reuters)]  [http://thehill.com/blogs/blog-briefing-room/news/365258-california-wildfire-becomes-states-third-largest-in-history (''The Hill'')]
*Six people are killed, including Hilda  Hernández, sister of [[Honduras|Honduran]] President [[Juan Orlando Hernández]], in a helicopter accident that was headed  to [[Comayagua]] from  [[Toncontín International Airport]] in [[Tegucigalpa]].  [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-honduras-crash/honduran-helicopter-crash-kills-six-including-presidents-sister-idUSKBN1EB001 (Reuters)]
*Five people are killed and at least 15 missing in a mudslide in Villa Santa Lucía, a remote village in southern [[Chile]],  after more than 4.5 inches (11.4 cm) of rain the previous 24 hours.  [[President of Chile|President]] [[Michelle Bachelet]] declares a state of emergency.  Sunday is the [[Chilean general election, 2017|run-off election]] for Chile's next president. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-42382413 (BBC)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/the_americas/chile-is-a-latin-american-success-story-so-why-are-voters-so-unhappy/2017/12/15/1de56e0a-caf8-11e7-b506-8a10ed11ecf5_story.html?utm_term=.3e643c53420c (''The Washington Post'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of Australia]]
**The [[Coalition (Australia)|Coalition]] keep a one-seat majority in the [[Australian House of Representatives]] after the [[Liberal Party of Australia|Liberals]] win the [[Bennelong by-election, 2017|Bennelong by-election]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2017/dec/16/bennelong-byelection-win-john-alexander-malcolm-turnbull-kristina-keneally (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Politics of South Africa]]
**Thousands of delegates of the [[African National Congress]] [[54th National Conference of the African National Congress|gather]] in [[Johannesburg]] to elect a party leader,  who may replace [[President of South Africa|President]] [[Jacob Zuma]] before his [[South African general election, 2019|term expires in 2019]]. [http://www.newser.com/article/e923995910c24dfb9816b2ae6bfee186/south-africa-ruling-partys-fight-for-its-future-kicks-off.html (AP via Newser)]

;Science and technology
*[[Advanced Aviation Threat Identification Program]]
**The existence of a U.S. government program that investigated reports of [[UFO]]s is revealed. [https://www.nytimes.com/2017/12/16/us/politics/pentagon-program-ufo-harry-reid.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Sports
*[[2017–18 NHL season]]
**[[NHL 100 Classic]]
***In [[ice hockey]], a [[NHL outdoor games|outdoor game]] is held at [[Ottawa]]'s [[TD Place Stadium|Lansdowne Park]] in [[Canada]] to [[NHL 100 Classic|celebrate]] the 100th anniversary of the [[National Hockey League]], which was formed in [[November 1917]]. The [[Ottawa Senators]] win the game in a 3-0 [[shutout]] against the [[Montreal Canadiens]] with Ottawa [[goaltender|goalie]] [[Craig Anderson (ice hockey)|Craig Anderson]] registering 28 saves. [https://www.sportsnet.ca/hockey/nhl/nhl-100-classic-photos-canadiens-senators-battle-cold/ (Sportsnet)] [https://www.cbc.ca/sports/hockey/nhl/ottawa-senators-montreal-canadiens-nhl-100-classic-1.4452931 (CBC)] [https://www.nhl.com/news/montreal-canadiens-ottawa-senators-game-recap-294101520 (NHL.com)]
*[[2017 FIFA Club World Cup]]
**[[Real Madrid C.F.|Real Madrid]] wins the [[FIFA Club World Cup]] for the second time, beating [[Grêmio Foot-Ball Porto Alegrense|Grêmio]] 1–0 in the [[2017 FIFA Club World Cup Final|final]]. Real Madrid becomes the first team to [[List of FIFA Club World Cup finals|win the tournament]] back to back. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/42370685 (BBC)]
